roads.name: Deaton Bridge Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 14 curves in 4.5 miles.
The 3 miles at the south end are tamer.
From 20 to 149 ft, with 225 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 25 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.14 g.
